name: Prompt Cache X-Ray conversations
description: Checks that the agent reaches for the right tool and reports only measured numbers: the built-in example, a pasted prompt pair, pricing a token count, and X-raying its own session (which needs two model calls, hence the two-turn case).

parts.text: Run the built-in prompt cache example and tell me where caching breaks and why.

Compare these two prompts for me.

Previous prompt:
System role: FinOps analyst
Request ID: req-101
Always answer in bullet points.
Never invent numbers.

Current prompt:
System role: FinOps analyst
Request ID: req-102
Always answer in bullet points.
Never invent numbers.
What does a call with 100,000 prompt tokens cost if 80,000 of them come from the cache, and what does caching save?
Price 50,000 prompt tokens with 25,000 cached on the model gemini-99-experimental.
Hi! In one sentence, what can you do?
Now x-ray this conversation: was your previous request's prefix reusable for this one, and how many cached tokens did the model report?
